{{Classification}}{{See|For other forms of currency in the ''[[Battlefield series]]'', see [[Currency]]}} [[File:Battlefunds.png|right]] '''Battlefunds''' were an in-game currency within ''[[Battlefield Heroes]]'' and ''[[Battlefield Play4Free]]'' that was purchased for real world money and allowed players to access certain items such as weapon or [[Battlefield Heroes Customization|clothing]]. They also gave players the ability to purchase items for longer periods of time and even allow them to be permanently purchased. Battlefunds had to be bought in blocks of 700 ($5 USD), and could be purchased from the in-game store or via SMS. They were replaced by [[Play4Free Funds]] on January 18th, 2012.[http://battlefield.play4free.com/en/forum/showthread.php?tid=64713 Introducing Play4Free Funds | Battlefield Play4free Official Site Forums, via VitalBullet] - retrieved February 13, 2012 Some exlusive items include: *Most [[Battlefield Heroes Customization|Clothes]] and [[Emotes]] *All modern and stylish weapons *[[VP Boost]]s and [[XP Boosts]] ==Payment Options== Items can be purchased for a limited duration of time or permanently with the exception of widgets. Widgets are available as package of a certain number of uses, like the Repair widget, or available for a time duration, like the XP Boost widget. ==VP Exchange Rate== Player cannot buy funds with Valor points and vice versa. Despite this, the average exchange rate is 1 BF is about 30 VP. '''Calculations:''' Super/Uber Weapons:
1 Day: 450 VP
14 Days = 210 BF
→ 14 Days: 6300 VP
→ 1 Day = 15 BF ⇒ 1BF = 30VP Bandages:
10 Bandages = 100 VP
50 Bandages = 35 BF
→ 50 Bandages = 500 VP = 35 BF ⇒ 1BF = 20 VP Throwing Knife:
5 Knives = 250 VP
45 Knives = 150 BF
→ 45 Knives = 2250 VP = 150 BF ⇒ 1BF = 15 VP Football:
5 Balls = 200 VP
50 Balls = 140 BF
→ 50 Balls = 2000 VP = 140 ⇒ 1BF = 14,3 VP ==Promotions== Occasionally, Battlefunds could be earned via in-game promotions, sales, contests and gifts. {| class="wikitable" border="1"; |'''Amount of Battlefunds''' | style="width:150px" | '''Original Bundle Amount''' |'''How to Obtain''' |- |{{bfunds|100}} | - |Awarded to players for reaching 10 million registered users. Given with the [[Battlefield Heroes Customization|"We are 10000000" shirts]]. |- |{{bfunds|700}} | - |Sign up to the EA Gun Club newsletter.[https://www.eurogamer.net/articles/2010-09-14-battlefield-heroes-gets-moh-items September 14th, 2010 - Battlefield Heroes gets MOH items] |- |{{bfunds|910}} |{{bfunds|700}} | rowspan="5" | Purchase the respective bundle from December 24th, 2010 (December 14th, 2010 for the {{bfunds|3,640}} bundle) to December 31st, 2010 during the [[Battlefield Heroes: Christmas 2010|Christmas 2010]] update using the code 2EE5-2GDZ-FKCQ-2E58.
